prompting.reader: paired frozen A1 T2-b reader and output head; addressed editor bypassed
prompting.single_edit_input: factual passage followed by the complete intervention command under full attention
prompting.ordered_pair_input: factual passage followed by first command, explicit Then separator, and second command under full attention
prompting.post_edit_readout: upper reader layers followed by the frozen per-variable output head

lora_matched.base: the same paired frozen reader and output head as prompting
lora_matched.rank_rule: integer rank 1-128 minimizing absolute distance to the paired canonical O3 trainable-parameter count; smaller rank breaks ties
lora_matched.objective: equal-weight changed-variable and preservation-variable cross entropy
